purpose.summary: Build native skip links across the complete owned Chronik startup graph before publication, preserving exact ancestry without native pointer borrowing.
scope: Direct child of signed public main 4e75154 integrated by PR60; two technical postimages plus finite policy, documentation and CI only.
After every owned parent link exists, sort active and side-branch indexes by height and call the existing native CBlockIndex::BuildSkip before publishing the graph.
Require the owned skip target to match the native logical ancestor while using a distinct address resolved from the owned hash map.
Retain the exact three-case owned-startup group, 593 assertions, 60-second deadline and all inherited native, service, ALP and plugin matrices.
exclusions: No Rust indexer, ALP parser/builder, plugin engine, dependency, consensus, activation, network identity, default or service-limit change.
No shortened startup owner lifetime, full-chain performance claim, server deployment, cutover, release or desktop integration.
No incoming report, raw output, binary, private history, host metadata, operator material or proof promotion.
